claims.text: The deterministic inflation pre-read puts the 12-month anchor at 3.008 against a 2.0 goal, leaving a positive gap of 1.008 percentage points — inflation running above target, which argues for tighter policy.
The inflation nowcast shows an even wider gap of 1.113 percentage points with a 12-month anchor of 3.113, reinforcing the above-goal reading.
Short-run CPI momentum is hot, with the 3-month CPI at 3.412, well above the 2.0 goal and above the 12-month CPI of 2.789 — accelerating prices argue hawkishly.
Momentum is mixed, however: the 3-month core measure at 2.046 is close to the 2.0 goal even though the 6-month at 2.744 remains elevated, which tempers the hawkish case somewhat.
The committee revised its 2026 PCE inflation projection up to 3.7 and core PCE to 3.4 — both well above the 2.0 longer-run goal, a hawkish signal.
The latest SEP marked up the 2026 PCE inflation median from the previous 3.6 to 3.7, an upward revision consistent with hawkish pressure.
The most recent statement says inflation remains elevated and frames the rate increase as supporting a return to goal, a hawkish characterization of inflation.
claims.quote: Inflation remains elevated. Today's policy action will support a timelier return to the Committee's 2 percent goal. The Committee will deliver price stability.

claims.text: The prior statement also described inflation as elevated relative to goal and tied to supply shocks, again a hawkish read on the inflation side.
claims.quote: Inflation remains elevated relative to the Committee's 2 percent goal, in part reflecting supply shocks that have driven price increases in certain sectors, including energy. The Committee will deliver price stability.

output.summary: The inflation evidence argues hawkishly (toward a hike) at the 2026-10-28 meeting. The pre-read shows inflation above the 2.0 goal with a positive gap of 1.008 pp (anchor_12m 3.008) and an even wider nowcast gap of 1.113 pp; 3-month CPI at 3.412 signals acceleration. The committee revised its 2026 PCE projection up to 3.7 (from 3.6) and core PCE to 3.4, both well above goal. Both statements describe inflation as \"elevated,\" with the September statement framing the hike as supporting a \"timelier return\" to the 2 percent goal. The only tempering factor is the 3-month momentum reading of 2.046, near the goal. Net tilt: +6 bp (moderately-to-strongly hawkish).

output.summary: Across all inflation evidence the signal is hawkish. The deterministic pre-read shows inflation above the 2.0 goal with a gap of roughly one percentage point (gap_pp: 1.008, anchor_12m: 3.008), and the nowcast gap is even larger (gap_pp 1.113); short-run CPI (3m 3.412) is running above the 12m pace. The committee's projections keep near-term PCE (3.7) and core PCE (3.4) inflation well above target and revised the current-year PCE median up from 3.6 to 3.7. Both recent statements call inflation elevated relative to the 2 percent goal. The one mildly offsetting detail is that 3m/6m momentum (2.046/2.744) sits below the trailing anchor. On balance inflation argues for a hike/tighter stance, so the net tilt is hawkish at +6 bp. Not in the evidence: any explicit statement that inflation alone warrants a specific action at the 2026-10-28 meeting.
